entries.terms_note: Unofficial Yahoo Finance chart endpoint: undocumented, no service guarantee, and covered by Yahoo's own terms of use, which this project has not cleared for redistribution. Research use only; flag under project limits.
entries.data_note: close is Yahoo's split-adjusted close; adj_close also folds in dividends and is restated after each one, so it depends on the retrieval date.
